title: Fair and Explainable Credit-Scoring under Concept Drift: Adaptive Explanation Frameworks for Evolving Populations
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and explainability in credit scoring using traditional machine learning (XGBoost). While it includes a discussion section on 'Ethical and Societal Relevance,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks as a primary component of its methodology.
